description: This file defines the interface and factory for the ControlIpc class used in the Rialto client to handle inter-process communication (IPC) related to control commands. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and references to external protobuf-generated classes.

classes.name: ControlIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ControlIpc, implementing the IControlIpcFactory interface.

classes.name: ControlIpc
classes.description: Implements the IControlIpc interface for IPC control communication, managing shared memory, client registration, and event handling.

methods.name: getControlIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlIpc instance for a given control client.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ControlIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory file descriptor and size for IPC.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers the client with the IPC server.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for the control module.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to server events such as application state updates and pings.

methods.name: onApplicationStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles application state change events received from the server.

methods.name: onPing
methods.description: Handles ping events from the server.
